overview_description.description:
PoloTab is a FoodTech and B2B SaaS platform built for restaurants, coffee shops, and food service businesses in Mexico. The platform helps businesses streamline their daily operations through an easy-to-use point-of-sale system that integrates sales, payments, inventory management, delivery integrations, a kitchen display system, and real-time business reports.
PoloTab enables restaurant owners and operators to centralize their operations, reduce manual work, improve visibility across their business, and make better decisions with real-time data.

about_short_description.short_description: PoloTab is a software company that develops POS and management solutions for LatAm restaurants and Coffee Shops.

product.name: PoloTab POS
product.description: A point-of-sale system designed for restaurants and cafes to manage sales transactions quickly and intuitively, operable even without internet.

product.name: PoloTab Reporting
product.description: A real-time reporting tool that provides detailed sales, revenue, cost, and product performance data for restaurant management.

product.name: PoloTab Delivery Apps Integration
product.description: A system that consolidates orders from multiple delivery platforms like Uber Eats, Rappi, and DiDi Food into a single interface for easier management.

product.name: PoloTab Inventory Management
product.description: An automated inventory system that tracks products, manages stock levels, costs recipes, and provides real-time inventory reports for restaurants.

product.name: PoloTab Billing (Facturación)
product.description: A billing system that generates consumption invoices instantly, allowing customers to enter their tax data and automating invoice issuance with QR code support.

product.name: PoloTab Security and Data Management
product.description: A system providing real-time data security, privacy, and traceability for sales, inventory, and financial information accessible via a secure portal.
